semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides specialized equipment and services for the semiconductor manufacturing process, particularly in the area of ceramic substrates and nanotechnology applications.
summary: Deright Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. is a provider of specialized equipment for the semiconductor industry, focusing on the manufacturing of ceramic substrates used in advanced packaging. Their offerings include spray dryers suitable for organic solvents, which are integral to the processing of materials in semiconductor applications. The company also offers manufacturing services and consulting related to heating, annealing, and curing processes.
capabilities: Manufacturing of ceramic substrates for advanced packaging
Consulting services for semiconductor fabrication processes
